decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The details submitted pursuant to conditions 11 and 37 (fume, odour and sound attenuation) of planning permission 00657/P/P13 dated 1 July 2010; for 164 residential units, ancillary fitness suite and business centre, retail (Class A1 use) caf?/restaurant (Class A3 use) office (Class B1 use) and Public House (Class A4 use) together with access, public and private open space, basement car and cycle parking provision, public convenience, provision of a pontoon and use of arches 4 & 5 under Kew Bridge for boat club (Class D2 use), are considered to meet the requirements of the condition and relevant policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-P.1.5 (Noise Pollution) and ENV-P.1.6 (Air Pollution) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan, with the addition of the following condition:

(11)(i)
Details of any new commercial kitchen extract system to the Public House shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the first occupation of any A3 or A4 unit within the development. These details shall demonstrate, that when at maximum operation, the system would not result in noise that is more than 10dB(A) below background noise levels for the site. The kitchen extract system shall include the following details and implemented in accordance with any approved details prior to the first occupation of any A3 or A4 unit:
a) A three-stage filtration system, including grease filters, pre-carbon filters and carbon filters, to be located inside the building.
b) The point of discharge shall be a minimum of 1m above the eaves of the building the housing the equipment and positioned to minimise impact from odours on nearby dwellings.
c) The ducting shall be circular.
d) The ventilation duct shall terminate pointing directly upwards and shall not be fitted with a cowl.
e) The fan shall be isolated from the inlet and discharge ducts using flexible couplings.
f) The fan shall be mounted using anti-vibration mounts.
g) The duct shall be isolated
description: Details of control of fumes and odours including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant required by conditions 11 and 37 of planning permission 00657/P/P13 dated 01/07/2010 for 164 residential units, ancillary fitness suite and business centre, retail (Class A1 use) caf?/restaurant (Class A3 use) office (Class B1 use) and Public House (Class A4 use) together with access, public and private open space, basement car and cycle parking provision, public convenience, provision of a pontoon and use of arches 4 & 5 under Kew Bridge for boat club (Class D2 use).
